controls.objective: Make compliance evidence reproducible instead of screenshot-driven.
controls.requirement: Control evidence should identify the source system, query or collection method, collection date, owner, and reviewer. Manual screenshots should be avoided when source data can be exported or queried.
controls.risk: Manual evidence collection is hard to repeat, hard to review, and easy to misinterpret.
controls.test_method: Select a control sample and confirm evidence can be traced back to its source system and regenerated.

controls.objective: Limit privileged access to approved users and roles.
controls.requirement: Privileged access to production cloud accounts must be granted only through approved roles, use least privilege, and have a documented business reason.
controls.risk: Over-broad privileged access increases the chance of accidental changes, data exposure, and unauthorized administrative action.
controls.test_method: Review privileged roles and confirm each assignment has an owner, approval, and current business need.
controls.title: Privileged Access Is Restricted

controls.objective: Ensure human access is centrally managed and auditable.
controls.requirement: Human access to production cloud accounts must use central authentication with MFA. Long-lived unmanaged user access should not be used for normal operations.
controls.risk: Unmanaged human access makes account recovery, offboarding, and investigation harder.
controls.test_method: Confirm human access paths use central authentication and identify unmanaged IAM users.
controls.title: Human Access Uses Central Authentication

controls.objective: Maintain a reliable audit trail for cloud activity.
controls.requirement: Production cloud accounts must collect audit logs for administrative and security-relevant events. Logs must be retained long enough to support investigation and compliance review.
controls.risk: Missing or short-lived audit logs limit incident investigation and make control evidence harder to defend.
controls.test_method: Confirm audit logging is enabled, centralized where expected, protected from casual deletion, and queryable.
controls.title: Cloud Audit Logs Are Enabled And Retained

controls.objective: Ensure vulnerability and configuration findings are reviewed, owned, and remediated within defined expectations.
controls.requirement: Security findings for production cloud resources and software dependencies must be triaged, assigned an owner, tracked to remediation or approved exception, and reviewed on a recurring basis.
controls.risk: Unowned or aging vulnerability findings increase the chance that known weaknesses remain exploitable and make audit evidence difficult to defend.
controls.test_method: Sample open and recently closed findings and confirm each has severity, owner, status, remediation evidence, or approved exception.
controls.title: Vulnerability Findings Are Triaged And Remediated
